name: The Divide Trap — visual allegory

scenes.title: A DRIED-UP WELL
scenes.narration: A farmer threw a dead pig into a dried up well.

scenes.title: 80 RATS
scenes.narration: Within minutes, 70 to 80 rats jumped into the well, attracted by the smell.

scenes.title: EASY FOOD
scenes.narration: For them, it was easy food.

scenes.title: EVERY LAST BIT
scenes.narration: They attacked the pig together and ate every last bit of it.

scenes.title: MEAL OVER
scenes.narration: But the real problem started after the meal was over. When they tried to climb back out,

scenes.title: NO GRIP
scenes.narration: they realized something terrifying. They were trapped.

scenes.title: DAYS PASSED
scenes.narration: Days passed. The food was gone, but the hunger kept growing.

scenes.title: INTO HELL
scenes.narration: And within a few days, the well had turned into hell.

scenes.title: SURVIVAL WAR
scenes.narration: To survive, the rats started attacking each other. Then they started eating each other.

scenes.title: ONE BY ONE
scenes.narration: One by one, they disappeared.

scenes.title: ONLY ONE LEFT
scenes.narration: After about two weeks, only one rat was left.

scenes.title: BLOOD RED
scenes.narration: Its eyes had turned blood red.

scenes.title: PULLED OUT
scenes.narration: Then the farmer came back, lowered a rope into the well, pulled the last rat out,

scenes.title: RELEASED
scenes.narration: and released it into his field.

scenes.title: IT HAD CHANGED
scenes.narration: The rat had changed.

scenes.title: ADDICTED TO BLOOD
scenes.narration: It had become addicted to hunting its own kind, so it no longer ate grain.

scenes.title: HUNTING ITS OWN
scenes.narration: The moment it entered the field, it started hunting other rats like a maniac.

scenes.title: THE REAL GAME
scenes.narration: That's where the real game begins.

scenes.title: THE DIVIDE TRAP
scenes.narration: This is called the divide trap.

scenes.title: AT THE TOP: PEACE
scenes.narration: The people at the top never fight each other.

scenes.title: BELOW: CHAOS
scenes.narration: They simply create an environment where the people below start fighting each other until they destroy one another.

scenes.title: SOMEONE ELSE'S GAME
scenes.narration: The truth is, many people spend their entire lives trying to defeat others without realizing they've already become part of someone else's game.

scenes.title: BREAK THE CYCLE
scenes.narration: So don't fall into a trap created by someone else.

scenes.title: STOP FIGHTING INSIDE
scenes.narration: And if you ever find yourself trapped, don't keep fighting inside the trap.

scenes.title: FIND THE WAY OUT
scenes.narration: Find the way out.
